items.title: Trump Says His Son Will Pay Back Russian Businessman for Wedding Party
items.author: Zolan Kanno-Youngs
items.content: <article>The president said his eldest son, Donald Trump Jr., had decided to return the money, but defended the gift worth hundreds of thousands of dollars as “totally allowed.”</article>

items.title: Trump Has Tried to Ban Reporters From Government Spaces Before
items.author: Erik Wemple and Michael M. Grynbaum
items.content: <article>There are several instances where the president made an effort to stifle the work of journalists.</article>

items.title: How Trump’s Trade War Could Hurt Republican Efforts to Hold the Senate
items.author: Tim Balk, Oralandar Brand-Williams and Jesse Ellison
items.content: <article>In a handful of border states and industrial states that could decide Senate control, the president’s standoff with Canada has drawn criticism from voters, including some who supported him in 2024.</article>

items.title: Sherrod Brown Tries a New Retort to Criticism on Transgender Issues
items.author: Emily Davies
items.content: <article>A spot from the Senate candidate in Ohio seeks to dismiss the Republican Party’s focus on transgender rights as a distraction from economic issues.</article>

items.title: Russia Warns New U.S. Sanctions Law Would Harm Trump’s Peace Efforts
items.author: Paul Sonne
items.content: <article>President Trump signed the legislation, named for Senator Lindsey Graham, at the White House, but he has broad leeway to waive its requirements.</article>

items.title: Tracking Assault Weapons Bans Across the Country as Court Battles Continue
items.author: Aishvarya Kavi
items.content: <article>Here are the states that have sought to limit access to some of the most lethal firearms, as gun restrictions face new legal challenges.</article>

items.title: After North Carolina’s Gerrymander, Democrat Don Davis Trumpets His Centrism in 1st District
items.author: Olivia Diaz
items.content: <article>Representative Don Davis is seeking re-election in a district redrawn by state lawmakers to lean more Republican.</article>

items.title: Kennedy Center Supporters Rally Amid Fears of Trump’s Demolition
items.author: Chris Cameron
items.content: <article>Photos of President Trump reviewing a poster board with the title “Kennedy Center DEMOLISHED” spurred the largest gathering yet in support of the performing arts institution.</article>

items.title: Air Force Officer Charged After Protesting Trump Says He Spoke to Defend Constitution
items.author: Anushka Patil
items.content: <article>Major Jason Watson could face court-martial in what could become a rare test of a service member’s right to publicly dissent.</article>

items.title: F.A.A. Safety Request for the Top of Trump’s Arch: Eternal Fire
items.author: Luke Broadwater
items.content: <article>The aviation agency deemed the mammoth arch safe for air travel if it includes a constant flame and other safety measures to help make it visible to planes.</article>

items.title: U.S. and Denmark Reach Security Deal on Greenland, Trump Says
items.author: Zolan Kanno-Youngs, Jeffrey Gettleman and Anton Troianovski
items.content: <article>The full contours of the deal were unclear, but Denmark and Greenland both indicated they expected an agreement to be signed soon.</article>

items.title: Trump Says He Has Banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico From White House
items.author: Michael M. Grynbaum and Benjamin Mullin
items.content: <article>The president cited reporting from the outlets that he deemed “fake news.” It was unclear how such a ban would be enforced or defended in court.</article>

items.title: Appeals Court Restricts Trump Administration Deportation Effort
items.author: Mattathias Schwartz
items.content: <article>The ruling allows migrants to contest deportations to countries other than their place of origin. The case could head to the Supreme Court.</article>

items.title: Republicans Are Now the ‘Elitist’ Party, Voters Say
items.author: Jess Bidgood
items.content: <article>We spoke to independents who have soured on Trump.</article>

items.title: Russia Aims to Inject Chaos Into Elections, U.S. Intelligence Finds
items.author: Dustin Volz, Julian E. Barnes and Steven Lee Myers
items.content: <article>The Kremlin is once again seeking to undermine confidence in American democracy with online influence campaigns, U.S. officials said.</article>

items.title: F.A.A. to Roll Out New A.I. Tool for Washington Airports
items.author: Aishvarya Kavi and Karoun Demirjian
items.content: <article>The tool, called SMART, will crunch scheduling and weather data to predict and avoid delays. It will be deployed in the Washington region’s three major airports next week.</article>

items.title: Cost of Iran War Estimated at $43.6 Billion
items.author: Eric Schmitt
items.content: <article>For the first time, the Pentagon reported costs incurred by each armed service. The figures are almost certainly on the low side, congressional officials said.</article>

items.title: Judge Who Struck Down Trump’s Compensation Fund Asks: Will Trump Just Pay Allies Another Way?
items.author: Alan Feuer
items.content: <article>The question was raised at a court hearing by a federal judge who has already barred the fund from moving forward.</article>

items.title: Trump Courts North Korea’s Leader, but Might Need China to Reignite the Flame
items.author: Edward Wong
items.content: <article>President Trump has gotten no love back yet from Kim Jong-un. He could turn to Xi Jinping, China’s leader, to help set up a summit when Mr. Xi visits Washington next week.</article>

items.title: James Talarico, Seeking Black Votes in Texas Senate Rate, Wins Crucial Endorsement
items.author: Neil Vigdor
items.content: <article>The Congressional Black Caucus’s political wing backed James Talarico, who defeated a Black opponent in the primary. He faces Ken Paxton, the Republican state attorney general, in November.</article>
